arguments.message: Hi! Renaming the workspace only changes its display name – it doesn’t touch the workspace’s URL, API base path, or any integration/webhook identifiers. So nothing downstream will break. The only place the old name might still show up is in any email addresses or subdomains you set up separately; those are independent and won’t update automatically. Good luck with the rebrand!
